name: ScreenshotAPI.net
tagline: URL-to-screenshot API with full page, viewport control, and multi-format output
description: REST API that renders any URL (or custom HTML) in headless Chromium and returns PNG, JPG, WebP, PDF, or video. Supports full-page capture, viewport sizing, ad/cookie-banner blocking, lazy-load waiting, CSS/JS injection, text/HTML/Markdown extraction, bulk and scheduled captures. Authenticate with a dashboard API token as a query parameter.

auth.details: API key via token query parameter (e.g. ?token=YOUR_API_KEY). Key obtained from self-serve dashboard signup; can be rolled from Settings.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 7-day free trial with 100 screenshots; no credit card required.
pricing.paid_plans: Essential $9/mo (1,000 screenshots, 20 RPM); Startup $29/mo (10,000, 40 RPM); Business $175/mo (100,000, 80 RPM); enterprise/custom available

rate_limits: 20 RPM on Essential, 40 RPM on Startup, and 80 RPM on Business. The error docs list screenshots_limit_reached as HTTP 429 for RPM excess and HTTP 403 for usage-quota exhaustion.

example.response_snippet: With output=image: raw PNG binary body. With default output=json: {"screenshot":"https://.../shot.png","text":"https://.../content.txt","extract_markdown":"https://.../content.md", ...} (hosted file URLs + metadata; exact keys vary by options).

use_cases: capture a full-page PNG of any public URL
convert a live webpage to PDF with ads and cookie banners blocked
screenshot a site at mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports for visual QA
extract rendered page text or Markdown for an AI agent or RAG pipeline
run scheduled or bulk competitor page captures from a URL list
